scripts.build:render: npm run build --workspace=server && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.build:cpanel: npm run build:ftp && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.build:ftp: npm run build --workspace=client && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Recurse -Force client/dist/* FILEZILLA_PUBLIC_HTML/ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item -Force client/dist/.htaccess FILEZILLA_PUBLIC_HTML/.htaccess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
